description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'AutoComplete4' that demonstrates the use of an AutoCompleteTextView populated with contact names retrieved from the device's contacts database. It includes an internal adapter class 'ContactListAdapter' for managing and filtering contact data retrieved via a content resolver.

classes.name: AutoComplete4
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating contact autocomplete using a CursorAdapter

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, queries contacts, and sets up the autocomplete adapter.

classes.name: AutoComplete4.ContactListAdapter
classes.description: A custom CursorAdapter implementing Filterable to provide autocomplete suggestions with contact display names.

methods.name: ContactListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and cursor.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new TextView for displaying contact name.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds contact name data to the TextView.

methods.name: convertToString
methods.description: Converts a cursor's current row to a displayable string (contact name).

methods.name: runQueryOnBackgroundThread
methods.description: Performs contact filtering query based on the user's input constraint.
